IEAGHG (2016). Techno-Economic Evaluation of Retrofitting CCS in a Market Pulp Mill and an Integrated Pulp and Board Mill ("CCS in P&P Industry"). Report 2016/10, December 2016. IEA Greenhouse Gas R&D Programme, Cheltenham, UK. Prepared by VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland and AF Consult Oy (principal researchers Onarheim, K., Kangas, P., Kaijaluoto, S., Hankalin, V., Santos, S.).

Targeted pass over the 300-page report (IEAGHG overview + VTT/AF customer reports VTT-CR-01301-15 reference-mill performance, VTT-CR-01312-15 reference-mill economics, VTT-CR-01051-16 CCS performance, VTT-CR-01712-16 CCS economics). Locators are PDF page numbers (each sub-report restarts its own printed pagination). Loaded: (1) the two reference mills as whole mills (Base 1A market kraft, Base 1B integrated pulp+board) and the 1A mill units per adt (wood handling, cooking, brown stock, O2 delignification+bleaching, pulp dryer, evaporation, recovery boiler, lime kiln per adt and per t lime, multi-fuel boiler, turbine island) with unit steam/electricity (Table 3), fuel, CO2, unit TIC at 2015-Q2 (cost annex Table 2) and maintenance factors; the board machine per adt board. (2) Mill-level CCS retrofit packages for single-source cases 2A-1, 2A-2, 2A-3 and 2B-1CO2MP per adt pulp (CO2 captured, % avoided, incremental steam/electricity, retrofit TPC, derived incremental fixed and variable opex). (3) Capture-plant and electric compression rows per t CO2 for the combined cases 2A-4, 2A-5, 2A-6MP; steam-turbine-driven compression and the auxiliary BFB biomass boiler for 2B-1/4/5/6CO2MP. NOT repeated (already loaded from Onarheim et al. 2017 = onarheim_2017_001/002): per-t-CO2 capture-plant TIC, compression TIC, CAC and capture steam/electricity flows for 2A-1..2A-3. 2B-2 and 2B-3 capture plants equal 2A-2/2A-3; their mill-level costs are in other-values. Not loaded: non-GHG emissions, water balances, sensitivity charts, policy scenarios 2-6. Reference-mill unit capex is mainly reprinted from Kangas et al. 2014 (Nord. Pulp Pap. Res. J. 29(4)); unit electricity split follows the EIPPCB 2015 BREF distribution. LHV basis throughout. Steam rows are GJ of steam as tabulated (IP 30 bar, MP 13 bar, LP 4.2 bar, ULP 2 bar).

(1) Multi-fuel boiler fuel 9.86 GJ/adt (Table 3) equals 481 kg WET bark x 20.5 MJ/kg DRY matter; dry-matter basis is 3.94 GJ/adt, so the printed value and the whole-mill 42.37 GJ/adt fuel total are likely overstated. (2) Table 2 (PDF p.10) prints electricity export as 1127.2 MWh/adt; it is kWh/adt. (3) Steam turbine 2015 cost for Base 1B is 41 MEUR in VTT-CR-01312-15 Table 3 (PDF p.110) but 61 in the cost annex (PDF p.219). (4) CCS price year is Q2-2015 in the cost annex but 4Q 2015 in the overview. (5) CTO price 400 EUR/t in text (p.116) vs 500 in tables. (6) Mill unit TIC are 2005-Q4 costs escalated with CEPCI; the LCOP uses the 2005 TPC (878 MEUR).
